exposure: levels of free amino acids (FAAs) in human milk (HM)
levels of total amino acids (TAAs) in human milk (HM)
cohort: The study included mothers and their infants, with human milk sampled at 6 weeks and 6 months of lactation.
finding: Specific free amino acids (glutamine, glutamate, and serine) in 6-week human milk positively correlated with infant weight gain in the first 4-5 weeks of age, and free glutamine was lower in 6-month human milk of mothers with an allergy.
